rule: A string on the onboarding main path may not contain any of these as a whole word, in any case (regex \bword\b, flag i). Inflections are listed on purpose: the rule does not guess plurals. Advanced and Copy-details strings are exempt (docs/ONBOARDING-v0.4.0.md, principle 2). Read by smoke:onboarding-copy (the strings module) and by scripts/onboarding-welcome-probe.mjs (the rendered DOM), so the copy and the screen are held to one list.
